content.text:
Now I have a comprehensive picture. Let me compile the full audit report.

---

## UI Consistency Audit — Rankora `/src/pages/`

---

### Reference Standard: Dashboard (`Index.tsx`)

**Container:** `max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 space-y-6`
**Page title:** `text-2xl font-bold text-foreground`
**Page subtitle:** `text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1`
**Header layout:** `flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4` with title+subtitle on left, action button on right
**Action button:** `<Button size="lg" className="gap-2 shadow-md px-6">` (size lg, shadow-md)
**Stats cards:** `<Card className="border border-border/60 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">`
**Section headings (h2):** `text-sm font-semibold text-foreground` (very compact, not a large heading)
**CardContent padding:** `px-5 py-4` (explicit override)

---

### Per-Page Findings

---

#### 1. `Settings.tsx`

- **Container:** `w-full max-w-[700px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8`
- **Inconsistency — max-w:** Uses `max-w-[700px]` (arbitrary value) vs dashboard's `max-w-5xl` (1024px). This is a narrower column — intentional for settings but the value syntax differs from every other pattern in the Tailwind scale.
- **Page title:** `text-xl font-semibold text-foreground tracking-tight mb-6` — **DIFFERENT** from dashboard. Dashboard uses `text-2xl font-bold`. Settings uses `text-xl font-semibold` + `tracking-tight`. This is 1 size smaller and a different weight.
- **No subtitle on the same line as title** — the title is alone with a bottom margin; there's no header flex layout with an action button.
- **Cards:** Plain `<Card>` with no explicit shadow or border class — inherits component defaults only (no `shadow-sm`, no `border-border/60`). Dashboard explicitly adds `border border-border/60 shadow-sm` to its cards.
- **CardTitle inside cards:** `text-lg` (e.g. "Auto-rank resumes") — **inconsistent** with `JobDetailView` and `Team.tsx` which use `text-sm font-semibold` for card titles. No single CardTitle size standard is maintained.
- **Wrapped in `SidebarLayout`** (good, shared layout).

---

#### 2. `Billing.tsx`

- **Container:** `w-full max-w-[700px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8` — identical to Settings.
- **Page title:** `text-xl font-semibold text-foreground tracking-tight mb-6` — same inconsistency as Settings vs dashboard (`text-2xl font-bold`).
- **No page header action button** — makes sense for Billing, so not a bug, but worth noting the structural difference.
- **Cards are delegated to sub-components** (`AccountInfoCard`, `PaymentHistoryCard`, `UsageHistoryCard`), none of which add explicit `shadow-sm` or `border-border/60`. `AccountInfoCard` uses `<Card className="overflow-hidden">` — a different modifier from anything else.
- Same `max-w-[700px]` arbitrary value concern as Settings.

---

#### 3. `Team.tsx`

- **Container:** `w-full max-w-[760px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8`
- **Inconsistency — max-w:** `max-w-[760px]` — **different from every other page**. Settings/Billing/Profile/Changelog use `max-w-[700px]`; Dashboard/JobDetailView use `max-w-5xl`. Team sits at an intermediate, unique width.
- **Page title:** `text-xl font-semibold text-foreground tracking-tight` — consistent with Settings/Billing, still smaller than Dashboard's `text-2xl font-bold`.
- **Header layout:** Uses `flex items-center justify-between mb-1` with the team name on the right as muted text — **no action button in the header**. (Invite form lives in a card below.)
- **Subtitle** present as `text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-6` — matches Settings structural intent but is placed outside the FadeIn wrapper.
- **CardTitle inside cards:** `text-sm font-semibold` — matches `JobDetailView` style but conflicts with Settings' `text-lg` CardTitle.
- **Cards:** Plain `<Card>` — no explicit shadow or border modifier (same gap as Settings vs dashboard).

---

#### 4. `Profile.tsx`

- **Container:** `w-full max-w-[700px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8` — consistent with Settings/Billing.
- **Page title:** `text-xl font-semibold text-foreground tracking-tight mb-6` — same as Settings/Billing, different from Dashboard.
- **CardContent padding:** Uses explicit `p-6`, `px-6 pb-5`, `px-6 pt-5` overrides — **inconsistent with Dashboard** which uses `px-5 py-4`. The Profile cards are slightly more padded on all sides.
- **Account card inner h2:** `text-lg font-semibold` — correct as a secondary heading inside a card.
- **CardTitle ("Activity"):** `text-sm font-medium` — slightly lighter than the `text-sm font-semibold` used in Team's card titles. Minor inconsistency.

---

#### 5. `JobDetailView.tsx` (component, used inside Index)

- **Container:** `max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6` — matches Dashboard except `py-6` vs Dashboard's `py-8`. Consistent `max-w-5xl`.
- **Page title:** `text-xl font-bold text-foreground leading-tight` — **mixed**: uses `font-bold` (matching dashboard weight) but `text-xl` size (not `text-2xl`). Dashboard h1 is `text-2xl font-bold`. This is a noticeable downsize for what is a primary view title.
- **Header layout:** Has back-breadcrumb + title + subtitle vertically stacked on left, with action buttons on right — structurally similar to Dashboard's "My Jobs" header but not identical. The `sm:items-start` vs Dashboard's `sm:items-center` creates a different top-alignment.
- **Status badge:** Uses raw inline `span` with hardcoded color classes (`bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700`) instead of the `<Badge>` component used everywhere else for statuses in the Dashboard. This bypasses the design token system.
- **Cards:** `<Card className="flex flex-col md:self-stretch">` — no shadow or border modifier. All JD/upload cards lack `shadow-sm` and `border-border/60`.

---

#### 6. `Tasks.tsx`

- **Container:** `w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8` — **another unique width**: `max-w-3xl` (768px). Doesn't match any of the other secondary pages.
- **Page title:** `text-xl font-semibold text-foreground tracking-tight` — consistent with Settings/Billing/Team/Profile. Still diverges from Dashboard's `text-2xl font-bold`.
- **Header layout:** `flex items-center justify-between mb-1` with badge indicators inline in the title row, action button on right — the closest match to the Dashboard's header pattern, but uses `mb-1` + separate subtitle paragraph, while Dashboard uses `gap-4` flex container.

---

#### 7. `Changelog.tsx`

- **Container:** `w-full max-w-[700px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 space-y-6` — consistent with Settings/Billing/Profile.
- **Page title:** `text-xl font-semibold text-foreground` — missing `tracking-tight` (present on Settings/Billing/Profile/Team). Minor omission.
- **Title layout:** Icon + h1 in a `flex items-center gap-3` row — **unique pattern** among pages; no other page puts a Lucide icon inline with the page h1.
- **Cards:** `<Card>` with `<CardContent className="p-5 space-y-3">` — uses `p-5` (shorthand) rather than split `px-5 py-4` (Dashboard) or `p-6` (Profile). Minor inconsistency in CardContent padding.

---

#### 8. `CareerSettings.tsx`

- **Container:** `w-full max-w-[760px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8` — same unique width as `Team.tsx` (`max-w-[760px]`).
- **Page title:** `text-xl font-semibold text-foreground tracking-tight` — matches Settings/Billing/Profile/Team pattern.
- **Header layout:** `flex items-start justify-between mb-1` with Live badge + ghost icon buttons on the right — **no primary action button** in the header row, which breaks the Dashboard pattern of having a `size="lg"` action button.
- **CardTitle:** `text-sm font-semibold` — consistent with Team.tsx.

---

#### 9. `Admin.tsx`

- **Layout outlier:** Does NOT use `SidebarLayout`. Uses a fully bespoke `div.h-svh.flex` with its own `AdminSidebar` and `AppHeader`. Its `<main>` is `flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6` — flat `p-6`, no `max-w` constraint, no `mx-auto`. Content is full-width.
- Admin is arguably an intentional design exception, but it does not share any layout primitives with the rest of the app.

---

### `src/index.css` — Global Utility Classes

No custom `card`, `shadow`, or utility classes are defined. The file contains only:
- CSS custom properties (design tokens using `--rk-*` prefix for colors, sidebar vars, score vars, border radius)
- `@tailwind base/components/utilities`
- A font import (Inter)
- A `body` base style and transitions base rule
- A `html.disable-transitions` utility for theme switching

**All card/shadow styling is done purely via Tailwind utility classes on individual components — there is no shared `.card` or `.shadow-card` class.** This makes the inconsistency harder to enforce globally.

---

### Consolidated Inconsistency Table

| Property | Dashboard (reference) | Settings / Billing / Profile / Changelog | Team / CareerSettings | JobDetailView | Tasks | Admin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `max-w` | `max-w-5xl` | `max-w-[700px]` | `max-w-[760px]` | `max-w-5xl` | `max-w-3xl` | none |
| `py-*` | `py-8` | `py-8` | `py-8` | `py-6` | `py-8` | `p-6` |
| Page `h1` size | `text-2xl` | `text-xl` | `text-xl` | `text-xl` | `text-xl` | n/a |
| Page `h1` weight | `font-bold` | `font-semibold` | `font-semibold` | `font-bold` | `font-semibold` | n/a |
| `tracking-tight` on h1 | absent | present | present (CareerSettings), absent (Team inline) | absent | present | n/a |
| Card shadow | `shadow-sm hover:shadow-md` | none | none | none | none | none |
| Card border | `border border-border/60` | none | none | none | none | none |
| Action button size | `size="lg"` | none | none | `size="sm"` | via Dialog | none |
| Action button shadow | `shadow-md` | none | none | none | none | none |
| CardTitle size (in cards) | — | `text-lg` (Settings), `text-sm font-medium` (Profile) | `text-sm font-semibold` | `text-sm font-semibold` | none | — |
| CardContent padding | `px-5 py-4` explicit | `p-6` (Profile), `p-5` (Changelog) | default | default | `py-3` | n/a |

---

### Highest Priority Fixes

1. **Page title scale** — Secondary pages (`Settings`, `Billing`, `Profile`, `Team`, `Tasks`, `Changelog`, `CareerSettings`) all use `text-xl font-semibold` while the dashboard uses `text-2xl font-bold`. Choose one standard. If `text-xl font-semibold` is the intended secondary-page style, document it. If `text-2xl font-bold` is the global standard, update all secondary pages.

2. **Max-width fragmentation** — Five different `max-w` values in use: `max-w-5xl` (Index, JobDetailView), `max-w-[700px]` (Settings, Billing, Profile, Changelog), `max-w-[760px]` (Team, CareerSettings), `max-w-3xl` (Tasks), and unconstrained (Admin). Consolidate to two standards: one for content-heavy pages (`max-w-5xl`) and one for form/settings pages (pick `max-w-2xl` or `max-w-[700px]` and apply consistently).

3. **Card shadow/border missing on non-dashboard pages** — Dashboard stat cards and job cards explicitly add `border border-border/60 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md`. All `<Card>` uses in Settings, Billing, Team, Profile, and JobDetailView omit these, creating a flat/borderless appearance that differs from the dashboard. Either propagate the modifier or standardize a shadcn Card variant.

4. **Status badge raw `span` in JobDetailView** — Line 1037 in `JobDetailView.tsx` uses a hand-rolled `<span>` with hardcoded Tailwind colors for the job status badge. The Dashboard uses `<Badge variant="success|warning|outline">` for the exact same status values. Replace with the `Badge` component.

5. **CardTitle size inconsistency** — Settings uses `text-lg` on its CardTitles; Team/CareerSettings/JobDetailView use `text-sm font-semibold`. Profile uses `text-sm font-medium`. Pick one and apply via a shared CardTitle size convention.

6. **`py-6` vs `py-8`** — `JobDetailView` uses `py-6` at its top-level container while all other pages use `py-8`. A 2-unit vertical rhythm discrepancy on the main content view.
